notes.title: The first discount sale in 18 months has begun.
notes.content:
The 50% discount for all products has just started. It ends on June 4th.
The next discount will start with the release of a new game.
Unlike before, we have formed a team and are gathering all our capabilities, so please pay attention to those who like bondage fetish.
We will make a great product even if it takes a long time.

notes.title: v5.8 Patch Note
notes.content:
A self-healing factor has been added to the player.
The design of the stat upgrade screen has been simplified.
The rescued  girl's animation has been improved.
In-game info icon has been added.
The movement of the constellation has been reduced.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32727831/b491993dbaab4f16ae6ca55f2b426d88f31e0847.png[/img]

notes.title: v5.3 patch notes
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32727831/46a2211231fac07e183efa4522edc6a74330cb5c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32727831/4fcd6af9512b48cdffdd1c2779fc42edabc39afb.png[/img][/url]
Added glow filter switch button to option.
Mouse cursor does not exit in window mode.
Bonus Scene are skippable.
The girl keeps a certain distance from the player.
Ball gags are also available on the playground.
(Blind - Blind+Gag - Gag by "F" key)

notes.title: v5.1 patch notes
notes.content:
Enemy's movement route does not shake.
The game started faster.
Particle effects have been added.
Fixed the control at the end of the action.
Fixed the problem that tomorrow's achievement is accomplished.
Fixed mouse and camera sensitivity issue.




*I will update the rest of the big issues this week.
